narrative.overview: A pale editorial website with dark-green interactive diagrams, substantial Geist headings, and restrained controls. Extracted from local built source and review captures; not an approved comp, standing user preference, or publication claim.
keyCharacteristics: Explicit diagram relationships and selected states
dos: Do retain captions, connectors, and keyboard focus on mobile.
Do preserve state feedback under reduced motion.
Do keep product claims grounded in sources.
donts: Do not treat the provisional direction as a confirmed user preference.
Do not add simulated paper, ambient shadows, or unused component families.
